 Mr. Justice M.S.Raman
 Order
17.04.2023 Order No.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
2. None appears for the petitioner at the time of call.
Heard Mr. L. Samantary, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State.

3. On perusal of the record, it reveals that the petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking direction to the opposite parties 3 and 4 to provide a job under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Resettlement & Rehabilitation Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Resettlement & Rehabilitation Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Mr. L. Samantary, learned Additional Government Advocate raised objection pointing out the prayer made by the petitioner contending that though the land of the petitioner has been acquired in the year 2002, the petitioner claims the benefit as per 2013 Act.
According to him since the land has been acquired in the year 2002, the petitioner is not entitled to get the benefit under 2013 Act.
5. In view of the above, the prayer made by the petitioner is not sustainable.
Thus, this Court is not inclined to entertain the prayer made in the writ petition, which is accordingly dismissed.
(DR. B.R. SARANGI) JUDGE Arun (M.S. RAMAN) JUDGE Puspanjali Patel vs State Of Odisha And Others ..... ... on 17 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168724851/
